messages.subject: Re: Weight Calculator
parts:
Not sure such exists (video/blog/wiki). I've seen it regularly used to boost under represented classes or to give different weights to different observations depending on the value of one of the variables (in the sample audit dataset the RISK variable could be used to weight observations). The weights are passed on to a model builder if it supports a weights argument, or else multiplies out the dataset if it does not.

Regards,
Graham
